name: Red Lady

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health. Every 20-30 seconds she calls summoned innocents (up to nine alive); they cast disease.
Her Soul Drain hits everyone within 350 for 100 matter damage every 3 seconds for 30 seconds.
She cannot be hurt outside her tether.

story: The Red Lady keened for the innocent: the herders and children and hostages who died in Caimheul's wars and were owed a song of their own. When the voice from below changed her keen, they came back first. They come still, whenever she is threatened, small and sick and bewildered, and they carry their sickness to whoever they touch. She does not use them cruelly. She simply cannot bear to let them go. Her own song settles on those who stand near her as a slow drawing-out of the soul, a grief that takes as it grieves.
legend: Her innocents keep coming every half minute and they spread disease: kill them fast, cure the sick. Do not stand bunched near her or her soul drain eats the whole group. Fight her in her room. Some say it is cruel to kill the innocents. They are already dead.

aggro: Little ones, come home. Someone is here.

phases.text: Come back, come back, all of you.

death: Go on, little ones... go on now...

lairEntry: Small figures stand in a ring, swaying.

phases.text: The Red Lady keens. The innocent return.

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Red Lady's keen is ended. The innocent rest.

briefing: red lady calls diseased innocents every half minute. [kill them fast|aoe the innocents], cure disease, dont stack near her

loremasterTopic.text: She keened for the innocent dead of the chieftain's wars, and they come back to her, sick and lost. Her keen drains the souls of those near her.
